<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the only non‑aromatic carbon is the carbonyl at 196.40 ppm. All other signals (137.56 ×2, 131.90 ×2, 130.00 ×4, 128.40 ×4) fall in the aromatic region, totaling 12 aromatic carbon signals. Hence the molecule contains 12 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
